use_when: change a repo this session has not attached
gloss: The session attaches the repo with its add_repo tool and opens a pull request there, which runs that repo's own hook and checks.
caveat: Only a repo the account's GitHub app reaches, which the session's repository list shows.

use_when: make a small edit in a repo no session has open
gloss: You apply it with two taps in the Proposals view, and it lands as a commit, a branch or a draft pull request, as you choose.
caveat: Four kinds only: replace a whole file, set or remove one top-level JSON field, delete an issue.

gloss: One tap on the Stage puts the files in the folder the repo declares as its inbox.
caveat: New files only; it does not edit a file already there.

use_when: have Gemini do work on the laptop
gloss: A session files the errand; while the laptop is awake the daemon hands it to Gemini, and the output lands in output/<id>/ on web-tools-private's background branch.
caveat: An errand never commits to the repo the work concerns; a second step carries the output there.

use_when: have Gemini change a repo on the laptop
gloss: You start Gemini in Antigravity on the laptop, where it works in a local clone and proposes on a gemini/ branch.
caveat: Its clone needs npm run setup first, or the commit hook never runs and the derived-artifact check fails.

use_when: read a page a session cannot reach
gloss: You tap one bookmark on the page, and its result lands in courier/results in web-tools-private.
caveat: A courier script reads and returns; it never navigates or writes.

use_when: run a script on the work machine
gloss: You paste the script into the PowerShell ISE, run it, and paste its output back onto the errand.
caveat: No agent runs on the work machine and nothing there writes to git; the result returns only through your paste.

use_when: edit a file from my phone
gloss: You edit in GitHub's editor and commit to main or to a new branch.
caveat: No commit hook runs, so generated files stay stale until a session or npm run artifacts:refresh repairs them.

use_when: have Claude do a task on a schedule
gloss: A Routine starts a session with nobody there; code reaches main through a branch and pull request, tracker state directly.
caveat: The session starts from a fresh clone, with none of your files.

use_when: run a script on a schedule
gloss: The scheduled-tasks workflow runs it on GitHub's machines and commits the result to main.
caveat: GitHub's machines have CPU only and none of your files; a script that needs the laptop belongs in a daemon row.

use_when: work on files on my own computer
gloss: You work in Claude Code or Cowork on your computer, and the changes stay in a local copy until it pushes.
caveat: The work is invisible to every other session until it reaches a branch.
